text_markup: Some cards are written with self-referential language. If a card references its own name without using the word "copy", treat that name as if it said "this object".
text_plain: Some cards are written with self-referential language. If a card references its own name without using the word "copy", treat that name as if it said "this object".

examples.text_markup: The subroutine on the original printing of {card:Kitsune} includes the phrase "trash Kitsune." This phrase means "trash this ice.".
examples.text_plain: The subroutine on the original printing of Kitsune includes the phrase "trash Kitsune." This phrase means "trash this ice.".

examples.text_markup: {card:Boomerang}'s text refers to "a copy of Boomerang". This is not self-referential language and refers to any card named {card:Boomerang}.
examples.text_plain: Boomerang's text refers to "a copy of Boomerang". This is not self-referential language and refers to any card named Boomerang.
